rules.button_rule: Every visible enabled button/control must have a focused effect test plus keyboard/touch test when applicable; dead controls FAIL.
rules.oss_rule: AVAILABLE_LOCAL/ZIP/EXTRACTED is not integration. Require adapter + runtime wiring + focused test before DONOR_ACTIVE/RUNTIME_ACTIVE.
rules.copy_rule: Never create a downloader. If a required source is absent, enqueue/reuse canonical Motor2 and preserve source_repo/source_ref/hash/provenance.

node_template.acceptance_common: Focused browser test PASS; no dead enabled control; no second state engine; previous version preserved; exact path/blob/commit/run/job evidence.

execution_policy: Each tuple expands to node F-FE-<id>-<slug>. Only first dependency-satisfied node per Grok lane may be claimed. Every node gets a unique versioned product path/test/report/workflow determined from its segment and fresh latest version; claim must record those concrete paths before writing. Nodes 090-189 are preparation backlog, not evidence of completion.
